# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 113 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 52-53 | Coptic

---

## Saying 113

**1** His disciples said to him: "When will the kingdom come?" Jesus said: "It will not come by expectation. It will not be said: 'Look, here!' or 'Look, there!' Rather, the kingdom of the Father is spread out over the earth, and people do not see it."

---

**Translator's Notes (LOGOS):**

- "By expectation" — the kingdom is not an expected, anticipated event
- "Spread out over the earth" — the comprehensive coverage of the kingdom's presence
- "People do not see it" — the blindness as the problem
